title: When AI starts pressing buttons for you
description: GPT-6.2 targets professional work, Gemini takes on everyday tasks, and Microsoft and Salesforce connect customer systems. This issue also looks at data preparation, desktop permissions and why fairness audits need to be revisited as models change.

lumo-desktop-permissions.verification_scope: TechCrunch reporting on the desktop release, connectors and per-action permissions.

gemini-history-retention.verification_scope: TechCrunch reporting on Google’s settings changes, retention period and response.

sagemaker-data-preparation.verification_scope: AWS documentation on automated labeling, human review, data checks, regions and execution permissions.
